name: STI Co., Ltd.
summary: STI Co., Ltd. operates in the semiconductor equipment industry in Korea. Its products include central chemical supply systems, slurry mixing and systems, and chemical mixing / dilution system for mixing or dilution, and supply of TMAH, KOH, HF, NH4OH, and SC-1. The company offers wet station products, including initial, pre-depo, pre photo, and ITO; cassette cleaners, developers, glass slimming systems, strippers, etchers, after glass grinding cleaners, and photo mask developers; and fine metal, screen mask, and back side glass cleaners.
